about: Made-up data for the tests (tests/run_tests.py). The three tb-… stat blocks and the spell are invented for this project; the other stat blocks are SRD 5.2 (CC-BY-4.0) copies with a habitat list or an older name added.

monsters.name: Gloom Watcher
traits: If the watcher fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
actions: Multiattack
The watcher uses Gaze Rays three times.
Bite
Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
Gaze Rays

The watcher fires one ray chosen at random; roll 1d10 and reroll a result already used this turn. 1: Befriending Ray. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the watcher can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition for 1 hour. 2: Stiffening Ray. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the watcher can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. 3: Dread Ray. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the watcher can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. 4: Dragging Ray. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the watcher can see within 120 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Force damage, and the target's Speed is halved until the end of its next turn. 5: Withering Ray. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the watcher can see within 120 feet. Failure: 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. 6: Shoving Ray. Strength Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the watcher can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target is pushed 30 feet straight away and has the Prone condition. 7: Slumber Ray. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the watcher can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute. The effect ends if the target takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it. 8: Stonebind Ray. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the watcher can see within 120 feet. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of Restrained. 9: Scorching Beam. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the watcher can see within 120 feet. Failure: 27 (6d8) Fire damage. Success: Half damage. 10: Ruin Ray. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the watcher can see within 120 feet. Failure: 36 (8d8) Force damage.
leg: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the watcher can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The watcher regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.
The watcher makes one Bite attack.

monsters.name: Vault Magus
actions: Staff
Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.
Spellcasting

The magus casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17): At will: Light, Mage Hand. 2/Day each: Fly, Lightning Bolt. 1/Day each: Cone of Cold (level 9 version), Teleport.
react: The magus casts Shield in response to the spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Spells: Shield.

monsters.name: Daze Crawler
traits: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature that starts its turn within 10 feet and can see the crawler. Failure: Roll 1d8 for what the target does this turn. 1-4: The target does nothing. 5-6: The target moves in a random direction and takes no action. 7-8: The target makes one melee attack against a random creature within reach.
actions: Claws
Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Slashing damage.

monsters.name: Winter Wolf
traits: The wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
actions: Bite
Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
Cold Breath (Recharge 5-6)
Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.

monsters.name: Balor
traits: The balor explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the balor. Failure: 31 (9d6) Fire damage plus 31 (9d6) Force damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: If the balor dies outside the Abyss, it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
At the end of each of the balor’s turns, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the balor takes 13 (3d8) Fire damage.
If the balor fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
The balor has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
actions: Multiattack
The balor makes one Flame Whip attack and one Lightning Blade attack.
Flame Whip

Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 30 ft. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) Force damage plus 17 (5d6) Fire damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, the balor pulls the target up to 25 feet straight toward itself, and the target has the Prone condition.
Lightning Blade
Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) Force damage plus 22 (4d10) Lightning damage, and the target can’t take Reactions until the start of the balor’s next turn.
bonus: The balor teleports itself or a willing demon within 10 feet of itself up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space the balor can see.

monsters.name: Tough
traits: The tough has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the tough’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
actions: Mace
Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.
Heavy Crossbow
Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 100/400 ft. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.

spells.tx: A 20-foot-radius Sphere of lightless cold opens at a point within range. A creature that starts its turn there takes 2d6 Cold damage. A creature that ends its turn there makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 Acid damage on a failed save. Made-up spell for the tests.
